project_type: Node.js Discord bot with MongoDB + Payroll API integration
test_command: npm run dev (manual verification with commands)
verification_instructions: 1. Run node --check on all new/modified JS files to ensure syntax validity. 2. Start bot with npm run dev and verify modules load without throwing. 3. Test commands in Discord: /salary-notification-schedule, /salary-notification-roles, /salary-debts, /salary-debt-detail, /salary-pay-debt. 4. Verify schedulers initialize without error. 5. Verify notification preview calculation (check balance API call). 6. Test debt creation by simulating insufficient balance scenario.
environment_constraints: Never read env vars at module top level; always read inside functions (lazy evaluation) to prevent import-time crashes when env is absent. The existing apiClient.js throws at import time (anti-pattern). Mirror the lazy pattern used in other working modules. Bot runs with GuildMembers intent for member fetching. Timezone: Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code style: Vietnamese comments, EmbedBuilder for responses, admin commands require PermissionFlagsBits.Administrator, all roleId/userId are Discord snowflake strings, use node-cron for scheduling, MongoDB CRUD pattern from payroll.js, slash commands registered via discord.js, lazy env reading inside functions.
key_patterns: 1. Database CRUD: src/database/payroll.js - collection getters + async CRUD functions. 2. Scheduler pattern: src/features/payroll/scheduler.js - cron.schedule with config from DB, updateSchedule restarts job. 3. Command pattern: commands use SlashCommandBuilder, admin permission, embed responses, subcommands for list/add/remove. 4. Service pattern: payrollService.js - business logic, deduplication, coefficient calculation. 5. API client pattern: apiClient.js reads env at top (WRONG - needs fix), uses fetch with retry logic. 6. Index export: features/payroll/index.js exports all commands + scheduler for registration. 7. Registration: discord.js calls .toJSON() on commands, src/index.js calls init functions.
directory_structure: src/database/ - MongoDB collections and CRUD; src/features/payroll/commands/ - slash commands; src/features/payroll/services/ - business logic and API client; src/features/payroll/ - scheduler.js, index.js; src/ - discord.js (command registration), index.js (bot init); doc/api/ - API specs; doc/features/payroll/ - system documentation
